verdict.rationale: Mercury's first-party marketing states that cashback is earned automatically and deposited into the account with no manual redemption, and cites a 1.5% rate on credit card spend. This matches the story directly. Evidence is limited to homepage marketing claims. missing for 10: detailed program terms (eligibility, timing of deposits, exclusions or caps), independent or hands-on corroboration of automatic deposits.

support.subject: As a founder, I can earn automatic cashback on card spend without manual redemption steps

citations.quote: Earn unlimited cashback automatically deposited into your account — no manual redemption or confusing points.
